R0658.exclusion_reason: Education and citizen-science outreach program; the contribution is a collaborative education model, not a technical enabler.
R0658.one_line_summary: Describes a citizen-science education program in which school students built and used an agrivoltaic school-garden monitoring system; the contribution is educational rather than technical.
R0658.evidence_quote: This paper presents a model for PV education that brings together photovoltaics engineers with 6th-12th-grade students and teachers to test agrivoltaics applications using citizen science.

R1812.ai_methods_detail: M-MDNet deep image segmentation network with multi-layer multi-scale window attention (M-MWA), enhanced ASPP, and scSE attention; compared with mainstream segmentation models
R1812.validation_metrics: mIoU 90.35%, overall accuracy 97.61%, parameter count and computational complexity
R1812.one_line_summary: Developed M-MDNet, a deep segmentation network for infrared hot-spot defects in PV modules, tested on agrivoltaic (Hubei) and floating PV (Jiangsu) datasets, reaching 90.35% mIoU.
R1812.evidence_quote: Experiments were conducted on self-constructed datasets from an agrivoltaic power station in Hubei Province (HB_Data) and a floating photovoltaic power station in Jiangsu Province
R1812.site_name: Agrivoltaic power station, Hubei Province, China (plus a floating PV station, Jiangsu Province, China)

R1961.one_line_summary: Simulated energy (HelioScope, SAM), lettuce yield (AquaCrop) and rainwater harvesting for ground-mounted and rooftop-greenhouse semi-transparent agrivoltaic systems at Portland State; the greenhouse system performed far better.
R1961.evidence_quote: Solar output was modeled using HelioScope and the System Advisor Model, while AquaCrop and the FEMP calculator were used to simulate crop productivity
R1961.site_name: Portland State University, Portland, Oregon, USA

R3054.crop_or_livestock: Vegetables in grow towers with fish (aquaponics)
R3054.one_line_summary: Designed a container-based aquaponics farm for tropical climates and simulated incident radiation on semi-transparent BIPV panels and grow towers to select the most effective panel setup.
R3054.evidence_quote: Using semi-transparent building-integrated photovoltaic (BIPV) technology, simulations and analyzes of incident radiation on BIPV solar panels and grow towers were also conducted

R0012.exclusion_reason: Review-type overview of realized agro-photovoltaic solutions with a project planning description.
R0012.one_line_summary: Overview of realized agro-photovoltaic solutions worldwide plus planning of a project at the ZalaZONE test center in Hungary; a review-type paper.
R0012.evidence_quote: This study offers a more detailed overview of currently realized solutions around the world

R2766.ai_methods_detail: Two-stage pipeline: MobileNetV2-based CNN regression for leaf counts from top-view images, refined by U-Net segmentation; pseudo-labeling
R2766.validation_metrics: R2 0.7-0.9; predictions within +/-3 leaves of manual counts
R2766.one_line_summary: Developed a two-stage MobileNetV2 CNN regression and U-Net pipeline for tomato leaf counting from weekly images in greenhouse and agrivoltaic greenhouse, achieving R2 of 0.7-0.9.
R2766.evidence_quote: This study presents the first tomato-focused leaf counting pipeline developed and validated using weekly image data collected under greenhouse and agrivoltaic greenhouse conditions.
R2766.site_name: Greenhouse and agrivoltaic greenhouse (location not reported)

R2770.one_line_summary: Proposed an 88 kWp agrivoltaic system with rainwater harvesting for semi-arid Moraujo, Brazil, using AHP-TOPSIS-2N siting and PVsyst simulation; income lifts a family above the poverty line.
R2770.evidence_quote: the definition of a modular support structure that allows water harvesting, and the simulation of technical and financial performance using PVsyst software.
R2770.site_name: Moraujo municipality, Brazilian semi-arid region (Ceara), Brazil

R2317.one_line_summary: Coupled a benefit-cost framework with crop and solar energy models for soybean agrivoltaic designs in the US Midwest, finding AV less profitable than PV alone for developers and farmers.
R2317.evidence_quote: We integrate it with a crop and solar energy model to simulate the performance of various field designs and space and height configurations

R0442.exclusion_reason: PV module technology development (micro-tracking concentrator modules); agrivoltaics is only a discussed prospective application, no agrivoltaic system studied.
R0442.one_line_summary: Presents hybrid and translucent micro-tracking concentrator PV modules with energy-yield simulations; agrivoltaics is discussed only as a prospective application of the translucent architecture.
R0442.evidence_quote: We discuss the perspectives of the translucent modules for dual-land-use applications as well, such as integration in greenhouses for agriculture-integrated PV (agrivoltaics).

R3178.crop_or_livestock: Shade-loving, shade-tolerant and shade-intolerant crops; potato
R3178.one_line_summary: Geospatially simulated elevated agrivoltaics across the EU at 25 km resolution to derive optimal ground coverage ratios for three crop shade classes, with energy, LCOE and LER estimates.
R3178.evidence_quote: three crop light requirements (shade-loving, shade-tolerant and shade-intolerant) are simulated at a spatial resolution of 25 km across the European Union (EU).
R3178.site_name: European Union arable land, 25 km grid

R1645.one_line_summary: Simulated a 450 kW elevated agrivoltaic system with hybrid rice in Jessore, Bangladesh using PVsyst, estimating about 680 MWh per year and favourable economics.
R1645.evidence_quote: Methods include simulation-based energy modeling, agricultural yield analysis under varying shading and microclimate conditions, and comprehensive financial assessment.

R0784.exclusion_reason: Review article on agrophotovoltaic systems; primary analyses are supplementary to the review.
R0784.one_line_summary: Reviews agrophotovoltaic systems and adds theoretical and small experimental analyses of crop transpiration cooling of PV modules in Nagpur, India; primarily a review.
R0784.evidence_quote: The objective of the current article is to discuss the various APV systems explored in the past and to highlight the futuristic APVs.
